director_prior.title: Kymaean Character & Image Direction — Pre-Candidate Director Intuition Synthesis 01

constitution.scope: Qualitative prior/challenge checks only; live frozen IMG-01 scores remain authoritative and unchanged.

conflict: the result is already a finished figurative depiction
faces/bodies/clothing carry too much recognition weight
it approaches the prior's prohibited decorative-editorial condition
it does not by itself establish identity that survives portrait removal/crop/reduction
concordance_findings.lawful_role: Retain only as an optional expressive depiction/artwork layer under usage restraint; do not make it the canonical Character identity carrier.

alignment: same person across changing depiction depth
conflict: the actual raw exemplar did not materialize the transforming-invariant mechanism and collapsed back toward conventional full-figure illustration
concordance_findings.lawful_role: Use the unresolved system question as successor evidence only; do not retroactively rescue IMG-F2 or reroll its consumed prompt.

alignment: environmental response can be meaningful when context warrants it
conflict: the prior says environmental response is optional rather than mandatory
the raw exemplar lets one sculptural field object outrank the people
spectacle weakens personhood and relationship rather than supporting them
concordance_findings.lawful_role: Retain only the contextual principle that shared space may respond to people; do not revive the rejected IMG-F3 surface/family.

system_conclusion.strongest_unresolved_canonical_identity_: How can one persistent Character remain recoverable across scale, crop, context, accessibility reduction and optional depiction changes without one fixed portrait or image becoming identity authority?
system_conclusion.reason: The method survivor and the Director prior separate two jobs that IMG-01 had intentionally explored together: expressive depiction can enrich Character presence, but canonical identity must persist beneath or without depiction. A deterministic system gate can test that architecture without result-aware rerendering.
